annotations.title: Add a brand guide or document

description: Adds a document for Marsell to read with the business: a brand guide, a positioning doc, a price list. Markdown or text, from a public https url, its bytes, or as markdown text. A PDF or Word (DOCX) file is kept, but it is read only where the server runs the sandboxed reader, which getmarsell.com doesn't yet: the answer's read says whether it was read, and the guide's words sent as markdown always work. It is kept whole with the setup's materials. For files on the agent's own machine, get_upload_link gives an address to send them to from your shell, so nothing big passes through your messages.

data_base64.description: Or the file's bytes, base64 (as large as one MCP message carries, about 4 MB).

filename.description: Its file name with its extension, when you have one.

markdown.description: Or the guide itself as Markdown.

url.description: A public https address of the file. Marsell fetches it itself (public addresses only, up to 8 MB).
